description: Burgers on the only raised kitchen in the game. A constant earthquake keeps splitting the room in two: tomato, lettuce and beef crates, boards and the sink on one side, buns, pans, plates and the serve on the other.
strategy: One chef chops on the low side and throws the food across the seam whenever it is closed; the high side fries, plates and serves. Dirty plates come back low, so wash in bursts and throw the clean ones up.
